WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT p.product_type_code,
           CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) AS qty,
           p.product_price
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Returned'
      AND co.order_date >= date((SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM Customer_Orders), 'start of year')
)
SELECT
    SUM(qty) AS total_returned_items,
    AVG(product_price) AS avg_restocking_fee
FROM filtered
GROUP BY product_type_code
ORDER BY total_returned_items DESC;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        c.customer_phone,
        SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) * p.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    customer_phone
FROM customer_spend
ORDER BY total_spent DESC

WITH order_points AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           co.order_id,
           co.order_date,
           SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS points
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, co.order_id, co.order_date
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           order_date,
           points,
           SUM(points) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_points
    FROM order_points
),
first_1000 AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(order_date) AS date_1000
    FROM cumulative
    WHERE cum_points >= 1000
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
total_points AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM order_points
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT tp.total_points AS total_points,
       f.date_1000 AS date_reached_1000,
       c.payment_method_code AS payment_method
FROM total_points tp
JOIN Customers c ON tp.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN first_1000 f ON tp.customer_id = f.customer_id
ORDER BY tp.total_points DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH revenue_by_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_phone,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = strftime('%Y', 'now')
                 THEN p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)
                 ELSE 0 END) AS rev_this_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = strftime('%Y', 'now', '-1 year')
                 THEN p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)
                 ELSE 0 END) AS rev_last_year
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_phone
    HAVING rev_last_year > 0
       AND (rev_this_year - rev_last_year) / rev_last_year >= 0.10
)
SELECT 
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rev_this_year DESC) AS rank,
    customer_phone
FROM revenue_by_customer
ORDER BY rank;

WITH yearly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_phone,
        strftime('%Y', co.order_date) AS order_year,
        SUM(p.product_price * oi.order_quantity) AS total_revenue
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, strftime('%Y', co.order_date)
),
revenue_comparison AS (
    SELECT 
        yr1.customer_id,
        yr1.customer_phone,
        yr1.total_revenue AS current_year_revenue,
        COALESCE(yr2.total_revenue, 0) AS previous_year_revenue,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(yr2.total_revenue, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((yr1.total_revenue - yr2.total_revenue) * 100.0 / yr2.total_revenue)
        END AS growth_percentage
    FROM yearly_revenue yr1
    LEFT JOIN yearly_revenue yr2 
        ON yr1.customer_id = yr2.customer_id 
        AND CAST(yr2.order_year AS INTEGER) = CAST(yr1.order_year AS INTEGER) - 1
),
ranked_agents AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        customer_phone,
        current_year_revenue,
        previous_year_revenue,
        growth_percentage,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY current_year_revenue DESC) AS rank_order
    FROM revenue_comparison
    WHERE growth_percentage >= 10.0
)
SELECT customer_phone
FROM ranked_agents
ORDER BY rank_order;

WITH max_yr AS (
    SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', order_date)) AS max_year
    FROM "Customer_Orders"
),
 yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c."customer_id",
        c."customer_phone",
        strftime('%Y', co."order_date") AS order_year,
        SUM(CAST(oi."order_quantity" AS INTEGER) * p."product_price") AS revenue
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON c."customer_id" = co."customer_id"
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON co."order_id" = oi."order_id"
    JOIN "Products" p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id"
    GROUP BY c."customer_id", c."customer_phone", order_year
),
 sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ys."customer_id",
        ys."customer_phone",
        MAX(CASE WHEN ys.order_year = m.max_year THEN ys.revenue END) AS revenue_this_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ys.order_year = CAST(m.max_year AS INTEGER) - 1 THEN ys.revenue END) AS revenue_last_year
    FROM yearly_sales ys
    CROSS JOIN max_yr m
    GROUP BY ys."customer_id", ys."customer_phone"
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_this_year DESC) AS sales_rank,
    "customer_phone"
FROM sales_agg
WHERE revenue_last_year IS NOT NULL
  AND revenue_last_year > 0
  AND (revenue_this_year - revenue_last_year) * 1.0 / revenue_last_year >= 0.10
ORDER BY sales_rank;
}

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
order_totals AS (
    SELECT co.order_id,
           co.customer_id,
           co.order_date,
           SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS order_total,
           CASE WHEN strftime('%m', co.order_date) = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_holiday
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.order_id
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT ot.*, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS total_cnt
    FROM order_totals ot
),
rec_cum AS (
    -- seed: first order of each customer
    SELECT customer_id,
           order_id,
           order_date,
           order_total,
           is_holiday,
           order_total AS cum_spent,
           is_holiday AS cum_holiday,
           1 AS step
    FROM ordered
    WHERE rn = 1
    UNION ALL
    -- recursive step: add next order
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.order_date,
           o.order_total,
           o.is_holiday,
           rc.cum_spent + o.order_total,
           rc.cum_holiday + o.is_holiday,
           rc.step + 1
    FROM rec_cum rc
    JOIN ordered o
      ON o.customer_id = rc.customer_id
     AND o.rn = rc.step + 1
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_email,
    c.customer_phone,
    (rc.cum_holiday * 10) + (rc.cum_spent / 1000.0) AS loyalty_score
FROM rec_cum rc
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = rc.customer_id
WHERE rc.step = (
        SELECT MAX(step) FROM rec_cum WHERE customer_id = rc.customer_id
    );
SELECT c.customer_name, c.customer_email FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_name ASC;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS order_total
    FROM "Customer_Orders" o
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ot.customer_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', co.order_date) IN ('11','12') THEN ot.order_id END) AS holiday_order_cnt,
        AVG(ot.order_total) AS avg_order_value,
        SUM(ot.order_total) AS total_spent
    FROM order_totals ot
    JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON ot.order_id = co.order_id AND ot.customer_id = co.customer_id
    GROUP BY ot.customer_id
),
loyalty_scores AS (
    SELECT
        ca.customer_id,
        (ca.holiday_order_cnt * 0.4 + ca.avg_order_value * 0.3 + ca.total_spent * 0.3) AS loyalty_score
    FROM customer_agg ca
)
SELECT
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_email,
    c.customer_phone,
    ls.loyalty_score
FROM "Customers" c
JOIN loyalty_scores ls ON c.customer_id = ls.customer_id
ORDER BY ls.loyalty_score DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH returned AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_qty,
           SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_refund
    FROM Customer_Orders co
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Returned'
    GROUP BY co.customer_id
),
max_qty AS (
    SELECT MAX(total_qty) AS max_qty FROM returned
)
SELECT c.customer_name,
       r.total_refund
FROM returned r
JOIN max_qty m ON r.total_qty = m.max_qty
JOIN Customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_name;

SELECT 
    c.customer_name,
    CAST(SUM(oi.order_quantity) AS INTEGER) AS total_products_returned,
    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) * p.product_price) AS total_refund_amount
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Returned'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_products_returned DESC

SELECT c.customer_name,
       SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_returned_products,
       SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_refund_amount
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Returned'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_returned_products DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH product_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.product_type_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS engagement_count
    FROM Products p
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    WHERE co.order_date >= datetime('now', '-12 months')
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_type_code
),
median_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(engagement_count) AS threshold_value
    FROM (
        SELECT engagement_count
        FROM product_engagement
        ORDER BY engagement_count
        LIMIT 20 + ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_engagement) % 2)
        OFFSET ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_engagement) / 2)
    )
)
SELECT 
    pe.product_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pe.engagement_count DESC) AS rank_number
FROM product_engagement pe
CROSS JOIN median_threshold mt
WHERE pe.product_type_code = 'Hardware'
  AND pe.engagement_count > mt.threshold_value
ORDER BY rank_number
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM Products p WHERE 1=0;

SELECT

    SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y-%m', co.order_date) ORDER BY SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) DESC) AS rank
FROM Customer_Orders AS co
JOIN Customers AS c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_name, month
ORDER BY month, rank;

votes.sql:
-- Note: The following query uses available schema elements. 
-- Key limitations: No loyalty tier column exists in the schema.
-- No separate region field exists (only address_details which is unstructured text).
-- Churn rate requires customer lifecycle tracking not present in schema.
-- This query provides closest approximation using order patterns over last 2 years.

WITH RecentOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.product_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.order_status_code,
        c.address_id,
        p.product_type_code,
        oi.order_quantity
    FROM Order_Items oi
    INNER JOIN Customer_Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= datetime('now', '-2 years')
),
ProductTypeSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        product_type_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers,
        COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(order_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(order_quantity) AS avg_order_quantity
    FROM RecentOrders
    GROUP BY product_type_code
)
SELECT 
    product_type_code,
    ROUND(total_quantity / NULLIF(unique_customers, 0), 2) AS items_per_customer,
    total_orders,
    ROUND(avg_order_quantity, 2) AS avg_quantity_per_order
FROM ProductTypeSummary
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

WITH orders_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.loyalty_tier,
        p.product_type_code,
        co.order_date,
        a.address_details,
        SUBSTR(a.address_details, INSTR(a.address_details, ',') + 2, 2) AS state
    FROM Order_Items oi
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN Customers c ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
),
quarterly_product AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_code,
        loyalty_tier,
        strftime('%Y', order_date) || '-Q' || (( (CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) - 1) / 3) + 1 )) AS quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders_enriched
    GROUP BY product_type_code, loyalty_tier, quarter
),
product_churn AS (
    SELECT
        product_type_code,
        loyalty_tier,
        quarter,
        CASE
            WHEN lag_customers IS NULL OR lag_customers = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (lag_customers - customers) * 1.0 / lag_customers
        END AS churn_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT
            product_type_code,
            loyalty_tier,
            quarter,
            customers,
            LAG(customers) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_code, loyalty_tier ORDER BY quarter) AS lag_customers
        FROM quarterly_product
    )
),
max_date AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_dt FROM Customer_Orders),
orders_recent AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM orders_enriched
    WHERE order_date >= (SELECT DATE(max_dt, '-2 years') FROM max_date)
),
quarterly_region AS (
    SELECT
        state AS region,
        strftime('%Y', order_date) || '-Q' || (( (CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) - 1) / 3) + 1 )) AS quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders_recent
    GROUP BY state, quarter
),
region_churn AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        SUM(churned) AS total_churned
    FROM (
        SELECT
            region,
            quarter,
            customers,
            LAG(customers) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY quarter) AS lag_customers,
            CASE
                WHEN lag_customers IS NULL OR lag_customers = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE GREATEST(lag_customers - customers, 0)
            END AS churned
        FROM quarterly_region
    )
    GROUP BY region
    ORDER BY total_churned DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
    product_type_code,
    loyalty_tier,
    quarter,
    churn_rate,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS region,
    CAST(NULL AS REAL) AS churn_count
FROM product_churn
WHERE churn_rate IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_type_code,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS loyalty_tier,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS quarter,
    CAST(NULL AS REAL) AS churn_rate,
    region,
    total_churned AS churn_count
FROM region_churn;

WITH fiscal_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date
    FROM Customer_Orders o
    WHERE o.order_date >= date((SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM Customer_Orders), '-1 year'
    ),
    revenue AS (
        SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
               SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_revenue
        FROM fiscal_orders fo
        JOIN Customers c ON fo.customer_id = c.customer_id
        JOIN Order_Items oi ON fo.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
    ),
    commission_calc AS (
        SELECT customer_id, customer_name, total_revenue,
               CASE
                   WHEN total_revenue <= 10000 THEN total_revenue * 0.05
                   WHEN total_revenue <= 30000 THEN 10000*0.05 + (total_revenue-10000)*0.07
                   ELSE 10000*0.05 + 20000*0.07 + (total_revenue-30000)*0.10
               END AS commission
        FROM revenue
    )
    SELECT customer_name AS sales_associate, total_revenue, commission
    FROM commission_calc
    WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM commission_calc);

WITH sales_30 AS (
        SELECT
            oi.product_id,
            SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_qty
        FROM Order_Items oi
        JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
        WHERE co.order_date >= datetime('now', '-30 days')
        GROUP BY oi.product_id
    ),
    avg_sales AS (
        SELECT
            product_id,
            total_qty / 30.0 AS avg_daily_qty
        FROM sales_30
    )
SELECT
    p.product_name,
    p.product_price AS inventory_level,
    CASE
        WHEN a.avg_daily_qty > 0 THEN p.product_price / a.avg_daily_qty
        ELSE NULL
    END AS projected_days_of_supply
FROM Products p
LEFT JOIN avg_sales a ON p.product_id = a.product_id;

The candidate SQL query fails to correctly answer the natural language question for the following reasons:

1.  **Incorrect Column Usage (Inventory Level):** The question asks for the "current inventory level" (typically meaning stock quantity). The database schema for the `Products` table does not contain a column for stock quantity or inventory count; it only contains `product_price`. The candidate query incorrectly uses `product_price` and aliases it as `inventory_level`. Price is not equivalent to inventory level, so the query returns monetary values instead of stock counts.

 sales AS (

     oi.product_id,

     SUM(CASE WHEN co.order_date >= DATE((SELECT max_order_date FROM max_date), '-30 day') THEN CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS total_sold_last_30
   FROM Order_Items oi
   JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
   GROUP BY oi.product_id
 )
 SELECT
   total_sold_all AS current_inventory_level,
   CASE WHEN total_sold_last_30 > 0 THEN total_sold_all / (total_sold_last_30 / 30.0) END AS projected_days_of_supply
 FROM sales;
